en: Well it might not be as warm or dry as I'd like, but it does the trick, huh? And these people are a hell of a lot more interesting than the whores I used to hang out with. Improvements all around.
What? You're not shitting me, are you?
Still here. What do you need?
You're an asshole.
Well, fuck you too.
You're a lot fucking stronger than you look.
Oh, fuck you, you little shit.
Fine. I don't need this shit.
Yeah that's a real good way to inspire loyalty, jackass. Fuck you!
Well thanks for making the terms of this arrangement crystal fucking clear, "boss".
Right. Leaving.

You think I've got enough time to cockslap the Madame on the way out?

On second thought, that would probably get me cockslapped by the ettins. Let's not and say we did.

Maybe they'll pay the next sucker something decent. More likely they'll just find another ettin with an appetite for half-assed handjobs.

You know what, fuck this place.
I think that's just about everything, not that I own much to start with.
I'm all set. You ready to go?
Oh, sure. I'll stay here until you're ready. I've put up with it this long, I can deal a little while longer.

Hey, can we talk? It's important."

Leftie sits cross-legged in front of the fire, a mountain of brown skin glistening in the light.

"It's important to me, anyway. You seen my brand, no doubt."

Leftie gestures to the scar branded on his neck. It reads "misanthropist", a brand you have not seen before or since. After letting you look for a moment, Leftie sighs deeply and hangs his head. 

"I'm gonna tell you how I got it, and then, I'm gonna pack my things. I don't want to go, but you of all people deserve to know.

|I'm not a good person. I've hurt lots of people. Crippled them. Sometimes it was an accident but sometimes it wasn't. Maybe I always thought I had good reasons.

Anyway, when I was young, I got locked up for fighting quite a bit. Maybe just a few days in the bricks here and there, but it was enough that I got used to it. Enough that they were keeping their eyes on me. 

Well, when I got older I got a little tired of it. It's no fun having your whole life come to a crashing halt just because you couldn't help but punch someone acting a raving idiot. I was on good behavior for a long time. I tried real hard, I swear I did.

|On my thirtieth birthday, I decided to celebrate by going out to the pub. Everything was fine. Someone found out it was my birthday, and those that weren't scared of me started buying me rounds. 

I was nearly drunk to death.

I remember a lady there, pretty as you please, with tits like prize pumpkins. She was real interested in me, and it had been a long time since I'd been with a woman, so I'm sure I was interested in her too.

|I say "I'm sure" because I don't really remember. 

Like I said, I was really, really drunk. That whole night is just a blurry spot.

The next thing I remember after that was puking my guts out, covered in blood, beat to shit, and strapped in irons. They wouldn't even tell me what I did until I got to the court and heard the judge read it out.

|The witnesses said I followed her home when the bar closed, broke into her house, and raped her. 

Then, her husband came home and tried to stop me, so I beat him to death in front of his wife. 

In order to make sure she didn't squeal, I strangled her to death too. 

Then, in a craze, I ate parts of them, and ultimately set fire to the house to try to hide the evidence.

They found me unconscious on the street, my mouth full of blood. The neighbor across the alley said she saw everything.

|Murder. Rape. Assault. Arson. Cannibalism. Buggery, for good measure, I suppose. I did so many things, they thought up a new brand just for me."

Leftie looks up, a profound sadness shadowing his face.

"I said I did it. I could have done it. I don't remember doing it, but I did awful things before. I don't know for sure that I didn't do it.

Maybe the alcohol really did something terrible to me, really fucked with my head. 

If I really did those things, then, I'm just the sort of monster who really belongs here on this island, locked away where decent folks don't have to be afraid of me."

|Leftie tosses a log into the fire, watching the sparks fly upward. His voice seems small and distant.

"So that's it. That's the kind of monster you keep under your wing. "

He stands up slowly, putting his hand on your shoulder before walking away. As he goes, his voice floats over his shoulder.

"I'll be ready to leave on a moment's notice. Just say the word, and I'll be gone.

You've been great. Whatever you're doing, I want you to know that I will always have the deepest respect for you. I know there have been ups and downs, but it's been a privilege to be along for the ride. Thank you.
I'm ready.
Oh. Um.. hi. Is it time?
Really? I don't know what to say, other than thank you. I've got your back. On my life, I swear it.
I think I've been ready for a long time now. Thank you for everything, and... goodbye.
Most of the locks I've seen so far are a much older design. Pretty simple to make keys for if you know what you're doing, which I do. Let me hook you up.
I got what you need.
Happy hunting.

I never mentioned this before, but this is quite a neat operation you've got here. Hell, you put together twenty people when I asked you to, and I think you could put together a lot more than that. Gives and old mind new things to think about.

You don't mind if I borrow your ear for a moment?"

Logus takes off his hat and gazes into the firelight, a tired expression stretched across his face.

"This may come as a surprise to you, but I was a naval captain before I was a Lukattite. For more than fifteen years, I sailed the waters between Crest and Tsarath, sometimes as a freighter, sometimes as a patrol. 

Nothing like it, being out on the water.
|Maybe I just got too cocky. Started thinking of the ship as mine, the crew as mine, the ocean as mine. 

I did my job, of course, but that became an afterthought.

I was often tasked with taking down pirates, but I often found ways to deal with them that didn't involve stringing them up. 

I was never specifically told to string them up, of course. Not at first, anyway, but when word got back to the nobility in Crest, they weren't too happy. 

I was reprimanded, given a stern warning and all, but you can imagine what I thought of that, I'm sure. 

|I kept doing things my way. I foolishly thought that there was nothing they could do about it. 

Eventually, they'd had enough, and put a sniffer in my crew.

We had on different hands all the time, so I thought nothing of it, really, but when we get back into port, they're waiting with guards, and this swabber turns around and puts me under arrest for defying the crown. What was I gonna say? I did defy the crown, didn't I?

|Well that was probably bad enough, but I fought them. My crew came to my side, or most of 'em did. 

It didn't matter. 

They beat us down, put me on trial, and executed nine of my sailors. They made me watch.

As for me, I'll give you three guesses as to what old Captain Logus' fate was. They wanted to make sure that all the other captains in their employ got the message loud and clear, and fell into line like trained hounds. 

|Well, I've been trying to find a way off this island ever since. I found that boat, but before you came along, I never managed to put together crew enough to actually sail it. 

Fat lot of good that did us. 

At least now we know our enemy, such as it is. I got no idea how we're gonna overcome a Sud'umKatch, but when you don't have any ideas, that's when you get creative, ain't it?

|Anyway, thanks. For everything. For getting me out of the shipyard, for lighting that beacon, for patching me up and bringing me along. 

You've done enough to prove to me that you're the stuff a real captain is made of, and for that, I salute you.

This fucking island. There is something really weird happening here. On the one hand, I'm glad to be a part of it, but on the other hand, it would be a lot easier to toss my hat into the sea and spend the rest of me days getting drunk at the shipyard. 
Ah well. This is more fun, probably. Nobody at the shipyard took me seriously anyway.
You want me to bring anything in particular out to the next raid? Or you just want me to stand by to carry whatever we come out with? EIther way, I'm good to go when you are.
You need somethin'?
Just let me know when we're heading out.
Carry your weapons? Rub your feet? You keep me sheltered and fed, and I'll do anything you want. Anything. As long as it ain't fighting, that is.
Whatever you need.
Don't leave home without me.
I ain't got magic or nothin', but there's still a lot I can do to make sure the injured recover as quick as possible. Just leave it to me.
Somethin' up?
'Course. Don't get yourself killed.
If you need some work done, just bring me two identical pieces, and I'll hammer 'em into something even better. You might wanna stand back though. There'll be hot slag flying all over the place.
Need your weapon worked?
Sure thing. I'll be here when you need me to do some hammerin'.
Get ready to die.
You're already dead.
It didn't have to be this way.
Damn.
Nothing.
I'm not afraid to die.
If we go down, you go down with us!
You can do better than that.
Shut up and fight.
Shut up.
When we're done with them, you'll be next.
You should have tried harder.
I won't miss you.
I don't do well in crowds. If you're going somewhere, take me with you.
Well, that's not surprising. I have that effect on people.
Nothing to say.
Hmm. Well, good to know I'm making you nervous.
Put me down already!
I will not be robbed!
Fine.
I will never be a slave!
If that's what it takes.
You're crazy. Ah well, I don't have anything better to do. Maybe you'll at least be entertaining.
You just don't take a hint, do you? Let me make this really clear for you - I kill people, and I don't feel bad about it. I've done it a lot, and I'll do it again. Leave me alone.
Look, I don't care. Leave.
You have to be joking.
Don't waste my time. Go away.

I'm gonna keep this short, but I've got something to say. 

How I got here, I killed a man who ran his mouth. 

I'm not sorry. I'd do it again. 

Killing him made me realize what a stupid joke it was for me to follow all those rules for so long. 

Everything felt like it was made of paper. I could hardly wait to get away from all that bullshit. 

|Life here is real. You work for what you have, and if you don't pull your weight, you die. It's simple, and I like it that way. 

Nothing pisses me off more than being disrespected, and the fact that I haven't buried an axe in you yet speaks to how you've treated me. 

I think you're someone who gets it, and I appreciate that. 

Anytime you need me, I'll have your back.
You need someone to knock some heads? I can do that. Just let me know.
You don't need me?
What is it?
Don't run your mouth if you aren't even sure.
Well, at least I don't have to play nice anymore.
You need access? Oh yes, I can do that. What kind of lock do you need opened?
What is it this time?
Just remember to spread it around a little.
The creature acknowledges your presence.
The creature seems to have noticed you, but is not attacking.
Hmph. A warmup maybe.
Watch me work!
How do you want to handle this?
Check this out.
Not this again!
I've lost enough!
Nothing to report, chief.
Have I been here before?
If I live, you owe me a beer!

See if you assholes 
can bring down Nazar!
Nah, we'll laugh about it later.

Just watch my back 
and we'll be fine.

Why do you have to 
be such a drag?

Stop whining and 
put your back into it!
Better you than me!
Wow, did you see that?

You just got shipped out recently, didn't you? I've been here for... oh it must be seven or eight years now. Seems like forever. There's groups of people here and there, little pockets of civilization, but they rise and fall so fast, a fellow scarcely has time to dry his boots.
You tired of looking at me already?
What can I do for you?
Nah, 'course you aren't.
Well, good luck with everything. On this island, you're gonna need it.
Why couldn't you just let me walk away?!
And be left defenseless? I think not.
How petty. Take it and leave me be.
I will never be anyone's fool again!
I've no wish to die. Let us see where this goes.
If you're satisfied.
Well then, pleased to be along. Where are we headed?

Sorry, I'm... finding it a little difficult to walk away. I worked here years ago, you see. Made some good friends here. Lost some good friends here too. I guess it's the closest thing to home I've had since leaving Tsarath. Hell, maybe even since before leaving it. Damned ogres.
Yes? Is there something you needed?
Really now? You did save my hide, so I am inclined to take you up on that. Provided you have some use for a meat wall like me, of course.
Well if you're going to change your mind, be quick about it. I won't be staying here reminiscing forever.

Did I ever tell you what happened with me? With Rangda, with Krade, and everything?

Rangda was my wife. 

Most orc men don't get to have a wife at all on account of us having so few women, but there I was getting married with a proper shot at kids and everything. 

I felt like the luckiest orc in the world.

|Of course, Rangda, she doesn't want kids. 

She's an orc through-and-through, that one, violent and impulsive as any of us. 

She wants to join the military, even though women aren't allowed. She doesn't care though, and she runs off to training camp with her boobs strapped down, and what can I do? 

We can't afford to be locking women up, so anything she does, I get the knocks for, and we both know it. 

|Well that's just what happens. Eventually someone finds out she's been lying and she gets booted. Everyone knows damn well it isn't my fault, but that's the law, and when you're an orc who wants a wife, you learn to be very good at following the law. 

Well, they decided to make an example out of her case, and they sent me way out here to Lukatt. 

Forever. 

I spent my entire life being the perfect orc so I'd get picked by a nice lady and get to have some cute little orc babies, and it wasn't good for nothing. 

Just a damn lie. 

|We're all branded here, but mine didn't even hurt. I knew it meant that worthless lie of a life was over, and I was glad to see it go.

Of course, it turns out the whole prison thing is just a damn lie too. They just throw us in this pit knowing we can never leave and hope that we'll kill each other. 

Well, once I got out of my bonds, I stumbled into a labour commune in the foothills, and those men took me in and treated me with more respect than I ever got back home. 

Can you imagine? My phony family gone in an instant, and I find a new, better one in a place that's supposed to be nothing but scumbags.

|Well, people came and people went and before I knew it, I'd been there longer than anybody else. 

They started calling me the foreman and lookin' up to me, and I looked out for 'em right back. Those guys were my everything to me. 

Krade was the mess sergeant at the camp, and he'd been on Lukatt almost as long as I had. 

Always fussing over the boys getting enough to eat and after them to wash their socks. He was a good guy, and we were close. 

|Yeah, I know what you're thinking, and yeah, it kinda was like that, but it was more than just finding a warm place to cram it. 

He would listen to me talk and just... really listen. He cared about what I wanted, not just about what he wanted from me, and he made me feel things I didn't think I deserved. 

I loved that guy. When he died in that accident... well we lost people in accidents all the time, but I missed him. Still do. 

|I got no idea why I felt like you needed to know this. 

Maybe it's because I'm starting to feel close to you too. 

Anyway, go on to bed, it's my turn for fire watch. 

And check your stash when you got a minute. I left you a little something.

We're really making a go of this, yeah? I've seen some things happen in my time here, but something about this feels good. And these people you've rounded up? Like check out that guy over there. Yikes. 
Anyway, whatever you do with all this, I'm with you.
Wait really? I can start wearing a shirt if it bothers you that much.
Just who I wanted to see!
Um.. you aren't really going to hold me to wearing a shirt are you?
Ah, dammit. I really ought to know better than to start getting attached.
Rest assured, I will do everything I can to ease the suffering of the injured. If our people are hurt while exploring, I will do my utmost to see them back to health.
Is there anything you need?
Take care of yourself, and everyone.

Ow. I just fucking banged 
my head on something.
Don't be an idiot.

If we're gonna be honest, 
that one was your fault.

You know, I could get used to this. Lots of hands to share the work with, lots of conversation at the fire. I sorta forgot what it's like being around this many people. Giants don't get opportunities like this every day, you know.
What can I do for you, shorty?
After all that? You can go fuck yourself!
You make a habit of beating the shit out of people who work with you? What the fuck have I got myself into?
Alright! This should be fun. Where we off to?

This place isn't actually mine. I just used it for a bit while working on this job. In fact, you can probably bring your crew in and camp out if you think it's a good spot. It's safe enough, nothing's really bothered me. 'Course, I'm fuckin' huge, so... you know. Not much bothers me.
Alright, I got just about everything. Ready?
You ready to go?
Hmm.. you know, on second thought, I should hit the shitter while there's still one handy. Give me a few minutes.
